name: The Ocean Club, A Four Seasons Resort, Bahamas
positioning: Low-rise resort on an eight-kilometre white-sand beach on Paradise Island, surrounded by Versailles-inspired gardens
best_for: Travelers who want a beach resort with gardens, three pools and an 18-hole golf course
Families with children ages 4 to 12 (Kids for All Seasons program)

facts.text: The resort is set within 35 acres of Versailles-inspired gardens.
The resort sits along an eight-kilometre white-sand beach on Paradise Island.
The resort has an 18-hole Tom Weiskopf-designed golf course, the Ocean Club Golf Course.
DUNE by Jean-Georges serves an international menu of signature dishes by chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten.
Ocean Blu serves Western Caribbean fare.
The spa has eight Balinese-style treatment villas, each with its own garden and outdoor bath.
The resort offers a Kids for All Seasons program for children ages 4 to 12.

highlights.text: The grounds include a 12th-century Augustinian cloister.
Every accommodation has a private terrace or balcony.
The Martini Bar and Lounge offers a custom martini flight of three mini martinis.
The Three-Bedroom Beachfront Villa Residence has a private infinity pool.
Premium Wi-Fi is a complimentary service.

considerations.text: The transfer from Lynden Pindling International Airport takes approximately 40 minutes.
Trattoria Versailles is a pop-up restaurant that serves lunch daily and dinner on selected dates.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the ultra-luxury positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
